name: @sentropic/s3-dag
description: Narrow, publishable orchestrator for acyclic DAGs whose state lives in S3 and whose nodes run as idempotent Kubernetes Jobs. No database, no permanent workers, no supervision server. Contract: acyclic DAG known at build, at-least-once execution, crash-safe reconciliation via immutable receipts + CAS (If-Match) state pointers. NOT a general workflow engine (no loops, human signals, or distributed transactions).
